programme.desc: After winning the trust of the Zephilim, Puss storms the Blind King's castle in hopes of saving his friends, restoring the true ruler of the Netherworld, and blocking the Portal for good.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots
programme.desc: When Puss and the gang return from the netherworld to find San Lorenzo overrun by thieves, they strike out to find the missing villagers.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants
programme.desc: As a prank, George and Harold use Melvin's new animal hybrid invention to create a creature that's a cross between a butt and a fly. But some of the monster butt-erflies want to eat everything in sight- including the students hiding out in the school gym!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants
programme.desc: After helping George and Harold make a comic featuring the heroine Plungerina, Erica asserts that Plungerina could be better that Captain Underpants. To prove her wrong, the boys decide to actually create the villain in the comic and then have Captain Underpants save the day. Unfortunately, Krupp - and therefore Captain Underpants - is away at a principals' convention.There's no one to save them...until a real life Plungerina saves tthe day! But who is really Plungerina?

programme.title: Go Dog Go!
programme.desc: Pawston is celebrating the 40th anniversary of Grandmaw and Grandpaw's Pawtomotive Garage! As a surprise, Tag and Paw decide to track down items to recreate the garage to look like it did when it first opened while the rest of the family distract the Grandpawrents. / Tag and Wind face off in the Lasagna Games for a chance to be Sam’s new Crew Chief. A series of lasagna-themed games will challenge their speed, fix-it skills, and leadership. But there can only be one winner.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop enlist Cruz’s help to perform a dance for Mom’s birthday. Though it’s hard at first, they learn to put their dolphin, unicorn, and narwhal powers together to create something special. / Kelp, Pixie, Ollie, and their friend Leroy try to help Juniper understand her angry feelings.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget).

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!).

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants
programme.desc: In hopes of raising their grades so they can go to Lake Summer Camp, George and Harold must teach Ratrick, their assigned rat, a simple task. But Ratrick runs away into the sewers where he is doused with toxic waste and transformed into Poopacabra! It's now up to the boys and Captain Underpants to stop the beast before it takes over Piqua with its stench, and more importantly, ruins the boys' chances to go to Lake Summer Camp.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: Bored of the viewing options on window, Thunk realizes what he’s been missing – real life drama! But when Thunk starts creating drama around the farm, the others set out to teach him a lesson.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: Sandy is finally old enough to join Grug and Eep for the annual Daddy Daughter Day and Grug couldn’t be more excited. But when Sandy struggles to fit in with Grug and Eep’s traditions, Grug has second thoughts. It isn’t until Sandy goes missing that Grug realizes it’s time to start a new tradition.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Yi and the crew are overrun with pings from humans who are frustrated by creatures they now live alongside. Just when they think they’ve solved one issue, another springs up – and then that original one pops up again too! Meanwhile, we see an ominous pedestal of light progressively become more cracked with each fraught human-creature relationship. At her wits’ end, Yi accidentally hurts Peng, Jin, and Everest with her magic. She then notices Everest fading into nothing….

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: In the wake of the previous episode, the magical creatures have all vanished and the world at large has gone gray. Desperate to fix things, the crew travels to the Magical Realm to confront the omniscient Great Watcher, who was a tempting offer for Yi. The kids manage to retrieve creatures, but being back in the human world is sapping them of their magical energy. Feeling responsible, Yi embarks on a dangerous mission to save everyone – but it’s the community of creatures and humans alike that instead come to Yi’s rescue. Together, they realize that their connections to one another are the most powerful magic of all.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: After the reveal of magical creatures’ existence and Yi’s magic ability in at the end of Season 1, the city’s citizens are unsure how to feel about this new revelation. A popular vlogger, Bryan Wu, sets out to capture viral-worthy footage of creatures and magic, under the guise of helping Yi and her friends get out their “creature awareness” message. Yi and the crew must step in when Bryan puts himself and creatures alike in peril in his pursuit of clickbait.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
programme.desc: Po and Blade rush to warn the Emperor about the weasels, but he has Po arrested and Colin captures Blade, revealing that she was never a knight. Thrown in a cell, Po reunites with Rukhmini and Mr. Ping, and he copes with the truth about Blade as they break out. Po fights Klaus and Veruca but is outmatched. Blade defeats Colin and hurries to help Po but is too late.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie. The group chases after Klaus and Veruca in an epic snowy mountain chase, culminating in Po saving Blade’s life as the weasels take off with the gauntlet and the whip. Rukhmini reveals that she actually has the real whip in her staff, and she knows where to go to get the next one: India.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight

Plus, Mo and Ty feel the need for speed, but will their huge bet pay off?

programme.desc: First, Michael transforms during a scaly science experiment that goes terribly wrong, and later, an employee bolts for help in the most outrageous reveal in Carbonaro history.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya Kanie, a handsome, scholastically successful and athletic high school student, freaks out when his classmate, Isuzu Sento, points a musket at him and demands he take her on a date to an amusement park.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya must accept the reality of his situation after learning that residents of the magic nation of Maple Land operate the park and receiving the ability to hear people's minds by its owner, Queen Latifah.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Circumstances land Seiya the position of acting owner for the park; he proposes reforms to meet the goal of attracting 250,000 visitors within three months, but the crew has a lot of complaints.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: With the 30-yen offer, the number of visitors slowly improves, but money remains an issue; attempting to find quick cash, Seiya visits Moffle, and they set off to search for a supposed treasure hidden in a cave.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Isuzu has mixed feelings about Seiya's expert handling of the issues at the park, even having nightmares about her own work; she resolves to fix the labor shortage by interviewing potential hires.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Summer arrives and Splash Ocean, the water park area, buzzes with guests; Isuzu, Muse and the other four fairies wear pirate costumes; Joe the shark notices something wrong in the machine room.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya collapses from fatigue and a cold after busily managing the park for the past few days; Seiya worries about his attendance at school, so Moffle and others pretend to be Seiya by wearing Mogoot Clan's magical clone suit and going to school.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Muse and others practice for a new show, but have trouble coordinating; Latifah decides to host a sukiyaki party to deepen their friendship.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Attendance increases after the park renovates some of the attractions and starts night parades, but Seiya grimly wonders if they can reach the target visitor count before the deadline.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: Seiya becomes more determined than ever after finding out Latifah's secret; he comes up with an idea that will help them achieve the target visitor count before the predetermined deadline and orders Tricen, the head of sales, to gather information.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.sub-title: No One Can Predict the Future!
programme.desc: The park sets a new attendance record after being selected as the venue for a soccer match; as visitors file through the entrance gates, Latifah prays for them to achieve the target visitor count; Seiya makes an announcement about the land they sold.

programme.title: Amagi Brilliant Park
programme.desc: The staff tries to put together a promotional video to attract more visitors to the park.

programme.desc: An alternate ending reveals that Tomoya and Tomoyo have been together longer than anyone thought; rumors surface about the couple.

programme.title: Golden Time
programme.desc: Koko finds Banri and Linda in a questionable situation; when things begin to unravel, Banri takes action to address the situation.

programme.desc: After going to the Awa Dance Festival, Koko decides to cook yakisoba for Banri, but he must remain blindfolded while she prepares the meal.

programme.desc: Banri, Koko, and the gang stalk Yana to find out if he has a girlfriend; Chinami is the first suspect, so they wait outside her house.

programme.title: Golden Time

programme.desc: Koko becomes depressed after the car crash and disappears; Banri goes to visit her in hopes of getting her back to normal.

programme.title: Golden Time
programme.desc: Koko insists that Banri should attend his high school reunion; Yana begins to connect the dots, discovering the secret of Linda and Banri's past.

programme.title: Golden Time
programme.desc: Banri and Linda return home for their high school reunion; in his absence, a lonely Koko decides to sneak into Banri's apartment.

programme.title: Golden Time

programme.desc: An unfortunate turn of events leads Banri down a path that could impact his entire life.

programme.title: Golden Time
programme.desc: After being dumped by Koko, a devastated Banri wonders if he will cease to exist.

programme.title: Golden Time
programme.desc: Banri and Koko discuss their breakup and make a promise to each other; the whole group gets together to try and revive their friendship.

programme.title: Golden Time

programme.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
programme.desc: A team of researchers is in Borneo to find the blood orchid, a flower that could hold the secret to eternal life. However, the scientists run afoul of the jungle's deadly snakes.

programme.title: Now You See Me 2
programme.desc: Dylan secretly guides the Horsemen as they reappear with a bold plan, only to be drawn into a tech billionaire's twisted scheme involving a powerful data chip.

programme.title: Final Score
programme.desc: When two terrorists kidnap former soldier Michael Knox's niece, he employs all of his skills to rescue her and possibly foil a plan of mass destruction as well.

programme.title: Backtrace
programme.desc: A thief suffers from amnesia after committing a bank heist and is imprisoned. Seven years later, he is injected with a drug that restores his memory so that he may recover the stolen money.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: Imprisoned at the International Space Station, a group of terrorists manage to escape confinement and take control of the ship. However, their mission to target the Soviets threatens world peace.

programme.title: Born to Fight
programme.desc: Dan Barnes, a former professional boxer, takes up the responsibility to coach Matthew Miller, a teenager who is repeatedly bullied by a school boxing champion and his friends.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: Megan Walsh, a special agent, is curious about teenage life experiences so she fakes her own death and enrols in high school. Soon, she realises the troubles of the high school life.

programme.title: City Lights
programme.desc: The Tramp falls in love with a girl with visual impairment who sells flowers on the street. He tries to help her gain her eyesight back with the help of a wealthy man.

programme.title: Rush Hour 3
programme.desc: Inspector Lee and Detective Carter arrive in Paris following an assassination attempt on Ambassador Han. There, they encounter a woman who may hold the key to uncovering the Triad's secret leaders.

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Rocky struggles in family life after his bout with Apollo Creed, while the embarrassed champ insistently goads him to accept a challenge for a rematch.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After their victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss and Peeta must participate in the 75th Annual Hunger Games, featuring all its previous winners.

programme.title: Black Adam
programme.desc: After being granted the divine power of the Egyptian Gods and spending almost 5000 years in a guardhouse, Black Adam is freed and decides to unleash his style of justice on the world.

programme.desc: A team of researchers is in Borneo to find the blood orchid, a flower that could hold the secret to eternal life. However, the scientists run afoul of the jungle's deadly snakes.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Jared, Sam, Bryce, and Amanda, four divers, come across a sunken plane with cocaine while looking for a treasure chest. However, things get complicated when they try to sell it to a kingpin.

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: A symbiote bonds with Peter Parker, intensifying his abilities and aggression. Now, he must face the challenges that his new powers bring while simultaneously fighting new villains.
